$comment: GATING FOR PROMOTION ONLY. Narrow clarification: how an S5-only G-E result is encoded when suppress publishes null. Blocks nothing in generation or Section 7.
question: S5 satisfies G-E scientifically while fewer than three S1..S4 qualify, so suppress = null. Does the promoted discovery document carry a G-E gate?

RULING.verdict: OPTION A. The S5 result remains in non-promoted validation and run evidence. NO G-E GATE appears in the promoted document.
RULING.engineer_3_gate_is_unchanged: The existing enforcement -- a G-E gate attached to a null Suppress direction blocks promotion -- is CORRECT and stays exactly as implemented. No gate change, no relaxation, no exception.

reasoning.a_gate_is_a_claim_about_the_published_ar: Gates in the promoted document describe what the published thing does. With suppress = null, nothing about suppression is published, so a G-E gate would attest a capability the published artifact does not have.
reasoning.the_specific_failure_it_prevents: A G-E PASS sitting beside suppress = null reads as 'suppression validated' to anyone scanning or tabulating the document. Someone builds a summary, sees G-E PASS, and reports the concept as bidirectionally validated when the tool only amplifies. That is the same reads-as-provenance-but-isn't pattern that has already cost this project a stub-judge certificate, a machine-local path, and a FAKE bundle passing a not-UNKNOWN gate.
reasoning.option_B_was_the_wrong_trade: Relaxing the gate would let a passing G-E coexist with an unpublished direction in every future document, permanently, to accommodate a case that is already fully recorded elsewhere.

the_science_is_not_orphaned.statement: Option A does not lose the S5 finding. It is already bound by existing machinery.
where_it_lives: causal_validation_record -- one of the four content-addressed binding evidence records the promoted document already references. S5's judged G-E result is inside it.
the generation manifest -- S5's outputs, hashes and seeds, as immutable pre-selection inventory.
the selection record -- S5 listed among unselected, with the direction's outcome.
the_science_is_not_orphaned.consequence: The finding 'only full ablation suppressed this concept' is hash-bound, retained and reportable. What it is not is a gate on a published capability.
the_science_is_not_orphaned.nothing_new_required: No additional evidence artifact, no fifth evidence_ref.

semantics.NOT_ATTEMPTED: No Suppress generation was performed for this concept and pairing.
semantics.NO_DOSE_CLEARED: Generated and judged; no dose, including S5, cleared G-E.
semantics.INSUFFICIENT_CLAMP_DOSES: Fewer than three of S1..S4 cleared G-E, so no publishable clamp triple exists. S5 may or may not have cleared -- see ablation_cleared_ge.

ablation_cleared_ge.semantics: Whether S5 / ABLATE cleared G-E. This is the field that carries the 'only full ablation suppressed this concept' finding into the promoted document as a FACT, never as a gate.

REQUIRED_ENCODING.why_two_fields_not_one_enum: Ablation clearing and clamp-triple sufficiency are independent, so enumerating their combinations produces a state list that grows and gets miscoded. A reason plus a boolean is unambiguous and cannot drift out of sync with itself.
REQUIRED_ENCODING.why_required_rather_than_optional: An optional field that is sometimes absent reintroduces the ambiguity it exists to remove: a reader could not distinguish 'suppress was never attempted' from 'the field was omitted'. Nullity discipline here mirrors the standing rule for generation_manifests and selection_records.

NOT_A_GATE.rule: PROMOTION NEITHER PASSES NOR FAILS ON suppress_disposition. It is descriptive metadata.
enforcement: suppress_disposition is validated for shape only: presence, enum membership, and the null_iff rule.
No value of reason and no value of ablation_cleared_ge may cause promotion to succeed or fail.
ablation_cleared_ge = true must never be rendered, summarised, tabulated or exported as a G-E PASS.
NOT_A_GATE.why_this_needs_stating: A boolean named ablation_cleared_ge sitting in a promoted document is one careless summary table away from becoming a de facto gate. Naming it non-gating in the schema is cheaper than discovering it in a report.

public_reporting.permitted: This concept publishes Amplify only. Suppression was attempted; only full ablation reduced concept relevance, and no graded suppression triple qualified for publication.
prohibited: reporting the concept as bidirectionally validated
showing a G-E PASS for this concept in any promoted-document summary
implying the public tool can suppress this concept
counting the concept toward any bidirectional or Suppress-validated tally
public_reporting.tool_surface: The public Suppress control is absent or disabled for this concept, per the standing null-direction rule. Unchanged.

unchanged: The accepted input schema. No change.
Every threshold, including G-E at -3.0 with coherence >= 6.0.
The four binding evidence records plus separate feature_certificate.
The causal dose grid, all five doses generated and judged.
The S1..S4 publication candidate restriction from mixed-operation v1.1.0.
Nullity mirroring across calibration.directions, generation_manifests and selection_records.
hard_stops: A G-E gate present in a promoted document whose suppress direction is null.
suppress_disposition absent when suppress is null, or present when suppress is non-null.
Promotion outcome depending on any suppress_disposition value.
ablation_cleared_ge rendered or exported as a G-E PASS.
Counting an Amplify-only concept toward a Suppress-validated or bidirectional tally.
